name: Field Canvas Tote
description: A heavyweight 16oz canvas tote built for the daily haul — groceries, books, laptop, whatever the day needs. Reinforced bottom seam, leather-wrapped handles that soften with use, and enough depth to fit a rolled towel or a stack of folders without straining the stitching.

name: Walnut Desk Organizer
description: Solid walnut, cut and sanded by hand, with three angled compartments for pens, cards, and the small things that pile up on a desk. No finish beyond a light oil, so the grain darkens naturally over years of use.

name: Enamel Pour-Over Kettle
description: A gooseneck kettle with a controlled pour, matte enamel body, and a wooden handle that stays cool. Built for slow mornings — 900ml capacity, enough for two full pour-overs without a refill.

name: Merino Crew Sweater
description: 17.5 micron merino, knit at a mid-weight that works from October through March. A close, un-fussy fit with a slightly dropped shoulder. Machine washable on wool cycle, unlike most merino this fine.

name: Recycled Wool Throw
description: Woven from recycled wool offcuts in a small mill in Yorkshire, this throw is heavier than it looks and holds its shape on the back of a sofa without slipping off. Herringbone weave, whip-stitched edges.

name: Aluminum Phone Stand
description: Machined from a single block of aluminum, this stand holds a phone at two angles for calls or video, and folds flat to slide into a bag pocket. No rubber feet to lose, no springs to wear out.

name: Slow Mornings — Essays
description: A collection of short essays on unhurried routines, kitchens, and the small rituals that structure a day. Hardcover, printed on uncoated stock, sewn binding that lies flat when open.

name: Ceramic Pour Mug Set
description: Two hand-thrown mugs in a warm speckled glaze, each one slightly different from the last. Wide enough for a flat white, sturdy enough to survive a daily dishwasher cycle.

name: Waxed Canvas Apron
description: A cross-back apron in waxed canvas that only gets better with stains and use. Two deep pockets, adjustable neck strap, no ties to catch on cabinet handles.

name: Leather Cable Roll
description: Full-grain leather, three elastic loops, and a snap closure to keep charging cables and earbuds untangled in a bag. Develops a deep patina within weeks of daily carry.

name: Linen Bed Sheet Set
description: Stonewashed European flax linen, pre-shrunk and softened before it ever reaches the box. Breathes in summer, insulates in winter, and softens further with every wash.

name: Fireside — Field Notes
description: A photo journal from three winters spent in cabins across the Pacific Northwest, paired with short field notes on fire-building, cold mornings, and the quiet of remote places.

name: Brass Reading Lamp
description: A compact reading lamp with a spun-brass shade and a warm, focused pool of light. Its weighted base and cloth-covered cord make it equally at home beside a bed or on a working desk.

name: Clothbound Travel Journal
description: A durable clothbound journal made for ticket stubs, lists, sketches, and notes taken on the move. The lay-flat binding and lightly textured pages are inviting without being precious.

name: Stoneware Olive Oil Set
description: Two glazed stoneware bottles with drip-free pourers for the oils you reach for most. A quiet, useful pair that keeps a countertop orderly and protects oil from direct light.

name: Hand-Thrown Serving Bowl
description: A generous, softly speckled stoneware bowl for salads, fruit, or a shared pasta at the table. The wide profile makes serving easy while the hand-finished glaze keeps every piece individual.

name: Oak Lounge Chair
description: A clean-lined oak lounge chair with a softly padded seat and a relaxed angle made for reading corners and slow evenings. Its neutral fabric and solid-wood frame sit easily with both modern and classic rooms.

name: Washed Cotton Quilt
description: A breathable washed-cotton quilt with a lightly textured finish and cotton fill. Layer it over the bed in warmer months or keep it folded at the foot for an extra bit of warmth.

name: Glazed Stoneware Bowl Set
description: Four everyday bowls in a deep earthy glaze, sized for breakfast, soups, and late-night noodles. Their weight feels substantial without being heavy in the hand.
